scenes.title: Be My Guarantor
scenes.summary: On the street, a colleague politely stops an employee not for spare change, but to ask him to co-sign an apartment lease.

scenes.title: Looking for an Apartment
scenes.summary: The colleague explains that everyone on the sidewalk is simply hunting for an apartment without a guarantor, and says his parents blocked him.

scenes.title: I Am a Freelancer
scenes.summary: Moved by sympathy, the employee agrees to fill out the guarantor form until he admits he is a freelancer without a company.

scenes.title: One-Year Deposit
scenes.summary: In the closing tag, a desperate caller begs a rental agency to accept a full year's deposit so he does not have to move back in with his mother.
